# Qt Lottie Animation QML Types

Provides QML types to display Lottie graphics and animations.


Import the types using the the following statement:
```cpp
import <@type>Qt</@type><@op>.</@op>labs<@op>.</@op>lottieqt

```

# QML Types




| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| LottieAnimation| A Lottie player for Qt. |
